name: Local file workspace
description: Folder-first content truth, directory tree, file operations, source fidelity, and optional exact-root version-control contracts.

invariants.title: The selected folder owns content truth
invariants.statement: Files inside the selected workspace root are the only active content truth; recent paths, tabs, indexes, recovery copies, previews, and optional version-control state do not become independently editable mirrors.
preflight: Name the selected root and every state object that only references it.
Define supported content and internal directories that never enter the content tree.
evidence: A real plain folder opens and edits without version-control metadata.
Restart and a second file consumer read the content written to the selected root.
Removing a recent-workspace record does not delete disk content.

invariants.title: Version control is an exact-root optional capability
invariants.statement: Version control is enabled only for the workspace root itself and never discovered from a parent; nested repositories remain ordinary content until opened as their own roots.
preflight: Separate workspace identity from optional capability state.
Define how nested metadata is hidden without hiding ordinary child content.
evidence: A plain parent folder containing repositories still has no version-control UI or change manifest.
Opening a nested repository as its own root exposes the capability.
The core file workflow succeeds when the capability is null.

invariants.title: The workspace model contains files and directories
invariants.statement: The formal workspace entry model uses root-relative paths and represents both files and directories with the metadata required by the tree, search, preview, and file-operation consumers.
preflight: Define entry identity, type, supported file kind, size, modification time, and optional capability state.
Assign ignore rules and internal-directory exclusions to one backend boundary.
evidence: The visible tree is built from formal producer output rather than hand-written consumer data.
Directories expand through the same root-relative identity used by file operations.
Internal metadata and trash never appear as editable content.

invariants.title: File operations migrate all path state
invariants.statement: Create, rename, move, delete, and restore enter one workspace-bound operation chain that resolves dirty content and external conflicts before mutation, then migrates tabs, recent paths, selection, search, recovery, and optional capability state.
preflight: Inventory every consumer of file and directory paths.
Define boundary escape, symlink, collision, overwrite, cancellation, and partial-failure behavior.
evidence: Unresolved save or external conflict blocks destructive mutation.
A successful move leaves no active consumer on the old path.
Directory moves expand to the exact affected file set.

invariants.title: Ordinary deletion is recoverable
invariants.statement: User deletion is confirmed and recoverable by default through the platform's system trash or an application-owned trash; permanent clearing is a separate confirmed action.
preflight: Separate deleting disk content from forgetting a recent workspace.
Define restore identity, collision handling, and platform-specific ownership.
evidence: A deleted item can be restored and is read again by the formal tree consumer.
Forgetting a workspace changes only application state.
Permanent clearing cannot occur through the ordinary delete path.

invariants.title: Unchanged source files remain byte-faithful
invariants.statement: Opening and saving a supported source file without a semantic edit does not rewrite its bytes, encoding, or line endings.
preflight: Keep editor state, preview state, and recovery copies outside the source-of-truth boundary.
evidence: A real unchanged file is byte-identical after the normal open and save chain.
A real edit changes only the intended content.
External modifications enter the formal conflict path instead of being overwritten.

invariants.title: Tree depth and region boundaries have one owner
invariants.statement: Tree indentation comes from one semantic depth rule, while navigation and content separators are drawn only by their owning region.
preflight: Budget disclosure control, icon, label, action, and indentation at the narrowest promised width.
Remove duplicate child-container, row, and icon-slot offsets.
evidence: Long names remain identifiable and actionable at supported depths and zoom levels.
Sibling rows align and child rows do not accumulate unrelated padding.
Content borders do not protrude into navigation.

invariants.title: Optional history starts with an explicit baseline
invariants.statement: When the product offers version-control enablement, the user previews and confirms the visible unignored baseline, and later automation includes only exact paths successfully changed through the application.
preflight: Show file count, total size, and ignore summary before initialization.
Define the application-owned change operations and keep unrelated external changes outside automatic staging.
evidence: Initialization creates a complete local baseline without silently adding a remote.
Application edits, moves, and deletes become exact changes.
Unrelated external modifications are not automatically committed.

checks.message: Selected workspace files must remain the active content truth.
The formal workspace model must represent files and directories.
Version control must remain an optional exact-root capability.
File operations must coordinate document state and migrate path consumers.
Ordinary deletion must remain recoverable by default.
Tree indentation must have one semantic-depth owner.

manual_verification.title: Plain folder core chain
steps: Create a real temporary directory without version-control metadata.
Open, expand, search, edit, save, create, rename, move, delete, and restore through the formal application entry.
Confirm no version-control command or change manifest was produced and no related UI appeared.

manual_verification.title: Nested repositories remain ordinary folders
steps: Create a plain parent folder containing two child repositories.
Open the parent and confirm child content is visible, internal metadata is hidden, and version-control capability is absent.
Open one child root separately and confirm the capability appears only there.

manual_verification.title: Dirty, conflict, operation, and path migration
steps: Create real dirty and externally modified files with open tabs and recent-path consumers.
Exercise rename, move, delete, cancellation, and collision behavior through the application.
Confirm conflicts block mutation and successful operations migrate every active path consumer.

manual_verification.title: Source-faithful save
steps: Open and save representative supported encodings and line endings without editing.
Compare exact bytes before and after, then make one real edit and compare the intended difference.
Repeat with an external modification and confirm the conflict path prevents silent overwrite.

manual_verification.title: Directory tree hierarchy and boundaries
steps: Render formal producer output containing long names and several supported nesting depths.
Inspect the narrowest width, promised zoom levels, themes, expansion states, focus, and action hit targets.
Confirm one depth rule owns indentation and navigation or content separators never cross regions.

manual_verification.title: Optional version-control baseline and exact changes
steps: If the product offers version control, preview and confirm a real unignored baseline.
Exercise application edits, moves, and deletes through a real repository and independent remote consumer.
Confirm exact application-owned changes arrive while unrelated external modifications remain outside automatic history.
